_method: Policy-aware expected outcomes. These expectations preserve the original policy interpretation while correcting unsupported monetary-basis assumptions. Room, ICU and domiciliary limits require Basic Sum Insured; doctor/surgeon/consultant fees require Sum Assured; other similar expenses require Sum Insured; ambulance requires Basic Sum Insured and the flat cap. Missing required monetary bases result in NEEDS_REVIEW when no decisive exclusion or waiting-period failure already determines the claim outcome. These expectations are established from policy wording and supplied case facts, not from system predictions.

PUB-001.rationale: The claim has room and ambulance expenses requiring Basic Sum Insured and doctor fees requiring Sum Assured. Neither amount is supplied. A complete payable estimate cannot safely be calculated.

PUB-002.rationale: The claim falls within the initial 30-day waiting period, with no applicable continuity exception.

PUB-003.rationale: The pre-existing disease waiting period is 48 months, while only 27 months of continuous coverage are established.

PUB-005.rationale: The day-care procedure is eligible, but doctor fees require a cap based on Sum Assured. Sum Assured is not supplied, so the complete payable amount cannot safely be calculated.

PUB-006.rationale: Hospital registration and medical necessity remain unconfirmed in the supplied evidence.
